name: Prateek "Shepherd" Boga
intro: In pursuit of excellence in all aspects, and hopefully never achieving it.
contextTitle: More than one way to explore.
context: I work in experimental infrared spectroscopy of molecular anions and astrochemistry. Away from research, I explore endurance running and cycling, write, and make art. This is a place to bring those pursuits together: the work, the process, and what comes next.
